programme.title: Combat Forces: Simulated Warfare
programme.desc: High technology is changing the modern battlefield. It is also changing training. In this episode, we examine the different types of simulators and other related technology that is being used to help make soldiers more battle-ready.

programme.title: Myths & Monsters: Change & Revolution
programme.desc: How does a community form? How does it survive and adapt to change? This episode details the role myths and legends have played in establishing the rules of society and the punishments for those who break them.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexico City
programme.desc: From ancient athletes who kick a severed head to a peasant dress that brings down an empire, discover the secrets inside the National Museum of Anthropology.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Dreamer
programme.desc: It is through our wildest dreams that we achieve new knowledge. We see dreams of feeding the world with insects, dreams of a synthesis of the fundamental theories of physics, and dreams of our future as extra-terrestrials.

programme.title: Combat Forces: Pathfinders
programme.desc: From ambushes to intelligence gathering, Pathfinders in most NATO armies are specially trained to tackle difficult and dangerous missions, like clearing the way for paratrooper mission. They are absolutely deadly soldiers who can get the job done.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Coming Home
programme.desc: Rookie waterbomber pilot Scott gets his first taste of action when Buffalo responds to an emergency callout to fight fires in Alberta. Mikey and Rod think they hit the jackpot when they buy a million dollar firefighting plane on eBay at a bargain price.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shut Down
programme.desc: Joe receives a negative visit from Transport Canada when inspectors threaten to shut down the airline. Ray and the Electra crew fly to Sachs Harbour to pick up a unique load - the hides, wool, and meat of 250 musk oxen.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Tale of Two Pilots
programme.desc: Weighed down by the responsibility of training a new rampie, and struggling to get out of Joe's doghouse, DC-3 co-pilot Tyler gets a once in a lifetime opportunity to stunt fly in his Cessna 150 for a visiting film crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Jam
programme.desc: After taking command of an intense airlift, and dealing with the ugliest Electra load he's ever seen, Scott takes a scary fall on the icy tarmac.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Very Buffalo Christmas
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north. But a series of problems with the Electra leave the company in a jam.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 204

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 205

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 301

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 302
programme.desc: Louise och Michael har vuxit ut ur sin lilla lägenhet i Århus och behöver mer utrymme. Paret gör en kompromiss och Louise möter sin största mardröm i huset som experterna köper åt dem.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Charlotte och Mikkel bor i en så liten lägenhet att duschen måste tömmas på saker varje gång de ska använda den. Men nu vill de flytta från staden med deras son.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Chloe Changes Her Ways!

programme.desc: Who was the sexual offender who murdered two adolescent boys in Nebraska? The key to stopping him would be the unique composition of the "junk rope" he used to tie his victims.

programme.desc: Mark Fair left for work and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead. During the autopsy, bite marks on her body were re-examined and forensic odontology identified the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Accident or Murder

programme.title: Forensic Files: Core Evidence
programme.desc: In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives. Each one of them had contracted a serious unknown illness. After one died, investigators knew the clock was ticking.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Haunting Vision
programme.desc: Fire engulfs the home where Lori Keidel and her siblings were left alone while their father went to the laundromat. Years after her mother's disappearance, Lori tells police she witnessed her mother's death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: With Every Breath

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Badge of Deceit

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dew Process
programme.desc: When the wife of a well-known dentist is found dead, police struggle to identify a suspect. Some fibers and a study of the weather patterns on the night of the murder break the case open and reveal the killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Monsters!/A Small Talent for War/A Matter of Minutes

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Welcome to Winfield

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programme.desc: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Dream Girl
programme.desc: A group of people find themselves trapped in a scenario with Otto, only to discover that he is a stagehand and they are a theater group all trapped in his dream.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A New Lease On Life
programme.desc: A man is overjoyed to find a nice apartment with all the modern conveniences at an incredibly cheap price. The eccentric landlady asks nothing more than for the man to provide her with plenty of garbage for the disposal unit.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Printer'S Devil
programme.desc: Junior Harman is a third-rate writer who discovers that his new agent, Mr. Kellaway, can make things happen for him. All it requires is a little blood - a few animals, the occasional bum...

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Shrine
programme.desc: A young woman, Christine, returns home to find her mother cold and distant, and living isolated from everyone else. The woman soon discovers that her mother has summoned up...Chrissie.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Old Soft Shoe
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Last Car
programme.desc: Stacey, a young woman on her way home from college for the summer, boards a train full of odd and bizarre mannered passengers. It soon becomes clear that this trip will end up being the ride of her life

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A Choice Of Dreams
programme.desc: A mob boss suffering from a terminal illness is visited by an odd man who claims that he has the ability to offer the dying a choice of dreams after death. The mob boss is skeptical at first and threatens to kill the man for insulting his intelligence.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Strange Love
programme.desc: Dr. Carrol reluctantly makes a late-night house call to treat Mrs. Alcott's leg injury. He discovers that Edmund and Marie Alcott are vampires, and that Edmund intends to keep him imprisoned. However, Marie disagrees with Edmund's plans.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Unhappy Medium
programme.desc: The family of a dead preacher shows up for a reading of the will but discovers he left them nothing specific. Rather, he warns them on his video-taped will that he will send them a sign.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Race, The Hubble, Chasing Comets & Space Debris
programme.desc: Cold War & The Start of the Space Race - Cold War rivalry and the acceleration of space exploration. Servicing Hubble - Preparations for Hubble's final servicing mission. Chasing a Comet - Launch and the difficult path to rendezvous.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Stars Above
programme.desc: The life cycle of stars reveal to us the past and the future of Earth and ourselves.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Invasion Mars
programme.desc: For over 50 years we have bombarded Mars with our probes and landers. Spying from orbit to map terrain, finding her strengths and weaknesses. The time nearing for the full scale invasion of the planet, when humans walk on Mars and claim it for their own.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Space is vast, yet it is full of collisions. Gas and dust electrostatically flock together, and gravity takes over coalescing grains into rocks. Those rocks become boulders, then asteroids colliding again and again, striking planets and each other.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna känner sig äntligen säker på sina känslor för Jake och har bestämt sig för att det äntligen är dags. Men hennes beslutsamhet stöter på hinder i form av moster Allys bröllop, en man från hennes mammas förflutna och en ränksmidande Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dålig tajming och avslöjanden förkrossar både Jenna och Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna är plågad av sina kärleksbekymmer och försöker komma underfund med hur hon ska reda ut sitt röriga kärleksliv tills ett oväntat SMS försätter hennes problem i strålkastarljuset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter att hon släppt sin blogg verkar alla ha åsikter om Jennas liv. Men medan alla andra finner det underhållande vill Jake och Matty ha svar.

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi löper amok när hon försöker få sin blogg att verka påhittad i ett försök att ändra sitt öde. Genom att omforma och undersöka sitt förflutna försöker Jenna komma underfund med sin framtid.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslut angående killarna offentliggörs. I kombination med en resa till Europa verkar allt gå som Jenna vill. Men något händer som får Jenna att ifrågasätta om det alltid är så bra att få allt man önskar.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Året i nian för med sig en våg av kanske livsavgörande överraskningar och förändringar för Jenna.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klasskamrats död får Jenna att reflektera over förluster, sorg och ansvaret hon har för hemligheten hon döljer för Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty är reserverad sen han upptäckt Jennas graviditetsskräck och Jenna gör nästan vad som helst för att undvika att tala om relationens framtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far tar saken i egna händer och talar med Mattys föräldrar om ungdomarnas förhållande.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: När Matty flyttar in hos Hamiltons, upptäcker Jenna att samboende kanske är mer än hon vill ha.

programme.title: iCarly: iHalvoween
programme.desc: iCarly-gänget håller en"Halvoween"-fest, eftersom de tycker att Halloween borde vara två gånger om året. Men när en utklädd gäst spelar Carly och hennes vänner ett spratt, urartar festen bortom all kontroll.

programme.title: iCarly: iStrid mot Chip
programme.desc: Spencer har en ny ärkefiende, Chucks lillebror, Chip. Freddie reparerar Gibbys leksakspistol och ger den krafter han aldrig kunnat föreställa sig.

programme.title: iCarly: iBlir Portad
programme.desc: När Carly portar T-Bo från hennes och Spencers hem, hämnas han genom att inte släppa in Carly på Groovy Smoothie. Under tiden upptäcker Freddie och Gibby att det finns många fördelar med att spela i ett band... och vissa nackdelar.

programme.title: iCarly: iTappade huvudet i Las Vegas
programme.desc: När Sam får veta att hennes mamma är i fängelse i Vegas, beslutar gänget att ta sina värdefullaste ägodelar, köra till Vegas och pantsätta dem, för att få tillräckligt med pengar för att betala borgen för henne.

programme.title: Bowie: The Man Who Changed The World
programme.desc: Ett nära porträtt av David Bowie, en av de mest kreativa och inflytelserika rockartisterna genom tiderna. Med exklusiva bidrag från dem som arbetade med David Bowie och arkivintervjuer med mannen själv.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Trail of Moche Gold
programme.desc: The looting of a gold headdress from an ancient tomb in northern Peru is recounted.

programme.title: Att leva med Folkrace!
programme.desc: Det här är dokumentärfilmen om Folkrace. Folkrace är den optimala motorsporten, alla kan börja åka utan att det kostar skjortan. Att köra folkrace är en livstil för många människor. I denna film får du följa många folkracefantaster

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Very Buffalo Christmas
programme.desc: A week before Christmas, Buffalo agrees to lend a hand to an RCMP initiative to fly toys to isolated communities in the north. But a series of problems with the Electra leave the company in a jam.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner
programme.desc: When South Korean buyers come to Buffalo to look at a water bomber, the pressure is on mechanic Cory to get the plane ready. But a landing gear emergency puts him and chief pilot Justin in serious danger.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV: Helt synlig
programme.desc: Megan och ett FBI-team slår till mot ett stort metamfetaminlabb, men tappar bort ledaren när han utlöser en bomb och flyr, vilket dödar en av agenterna under Megans befäl.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV: Toxin
programme.desc: En tidigare kemist på ett stort läkemedelsbolag upptäcks ha mixtrat med läkemedel och Don och Megan måste spåra honom.

programme.title: Numb3rs SV: Benhårt motstånd

programme.title: Teen Mom OG

programme.title: Teen Mom OG

programme.title: Teen Mom OG
programme.desc: Cate kommer underfund med att Brandon och Teresa vill diskutera adoption. Maci avslöjar att hon och Taylor väntar barn. Amber blir chockad när hon förstår att Gary väntar barn med Kristina.

programme.desc: Kommer en gammal fiskepall att ge stora vinster, och kan en fallskärmshoppande clown få ett stort genomslag på auktionen i Newcastle?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2203
programme.desc: I Yorkshire lär sig Roo om viktorianska loos medan David blir väldigt upphetsad över en vintageklocka. Två broscher och en katt av trä hamnar under klubban i Dundee.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2204
programme.desc: Roos huvud fastnar i en antikviteter medan David köper en tjur och en elefant. En händelserik resa i Skottland slutar med en glass och en auktion i Edinburgh.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2205
programme.desc: En hemlig karta som en gång användes av RAF leder David till potentiella vinster, medan en 350 år gammal bok får Roos uppmärksamhet. Vem vinner den sista auktionen i North Shields?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2206
programme.desc: Nybörjaren Irita Marriott tar med sig lettisk känsla till spelet när hon tar sig an Tim Medhurst i en sportlig tur i Lincolnshires antikvariat. En expert hamnar i konflikt med lagen.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2207
programme.desc: Tim och Iritas andra resa, denna vecka är de i Suffolk.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Martyr
programme.desc: To keep a student congress from being used as a rubber stamp by a repressive premier (John Larch), the IMF sets Phelps up for capture so he can betray Paris as a turncoat student leader on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Butterfly
programme.desc: The IMF attempts to clear an American businessman in Japan of false charges that he murdered his Japanese wife in "Butterfly," a segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible" series.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Homecoming
programme.desc: Phelps returns to his hometown on personal business, only to find his once happy surroundings in a state of panic caused by a mysterious series of deaths of the young townswomen on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Rebel
programme.desc: Phelps poses as an archeology professor and Dana as one of his graduate students, as the IMF goes to the aid of a group of young guerilla fighters in an effort to obtain from them a notebook containing vital scientific information in "The Rebel"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Killer
programme.desc: Robert Conrad guest stars as a professional assassin whom the Impossible Missions Force must prevent from Carrying out his assignment without knowing the identity of his target in "The Killer" segment of Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: MacGyver: There But For The Grace
programme.desc: MacGyver goes undercover as a homeless person to investigate the murder of a priest.

programme.title: MacGyver: Bind Faith
programme.desc: Pete Thornton agrees to take on the security of an old friend, political refugee Samantha Lora, but finds he can't do the job alone because of a worsening vision problem. He enlists MacGyver's help.

programme.title: MacGyver: Faith, Hope & Charity
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a mobster's search for stolen loot while nursing his injured leg at a country bed and breakfast run by two elderly sisters.

programme.title: MacGyver: Strictly Business
programme.desc: Murdoc is ordered to kill MacGyver in order to prove his loyalty to a professional hit squad.

programme.title: MacGyver: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a territorial dispute between an Indian reservation and an electric power company.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: Charlotte och Mikkel bor i en så liten lägenhet att duschen måste tömmas på saker varje gång de ska använda den. Men nu vill de flytta från staden med deras son.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 304
programme.desc: Pernille och Nicklas från Odense lever så litet att om de behöver lite privatliv har de bara toaletten att gå till. Nicklas drömmer om att ha ett kök med två ugnar så att han kan laga mer mat.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 305
programme.desc: Wendy och Jesper från Kalundborg bor redan bra, i en lägenhet som har en otrolig utsikt. Men en kommande familjeökning innebär att de måste hitta något större.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 306
programme.desc: Jonas och Louise blir chockade när de ser vilka hus de har råd med. Mads Mikkelsen och Tobias Edlev Nielsen arbetar övertid för att försöka uppfylla parets önskemål.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 307
programme.desc: Mads och Mia vill flytta lite utanför staden - men inte helt ute på landet. Med Tobias och Mads hjälp, köper de ett hem som har exakt allt de inte gillar.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Return Of The Mac
programme.desc: Nathan konfronterar Nathaniel, James sitter fast i en skotsk macka, och en chockerande återkomst hotar Chloes och Louis spirande romans.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Kiss Louis Goodbye
programme.desc: Louis satsar allt, men Chloe börjar tveka. Marty kommer att få återuppleva sitt förflutna, och en chockerande vräkning splittrar huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Just a Kiss?
programme.desc: Ant har dåliga nyheter till Louis. Chloe går på dejt med en modell, och huset ställs inför den hittills jobbigaste dumpningen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: Marty och Chloe går på dejt, Louis kan inte hålla tyst, och strax före den stora utekvällen kommer ett chockerande besked.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Out Out
programme.desc: Fyra nyanlända hotar allt. James har stora planer för Roxys födelsedag. Kommer Marty och Louis att förstöra den stora utekvällen?

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Make Or Break
programme.desc: Marty ger Chloe en chock, Ant pressar Molly till bristningsgränsen, och Geordiegänget ställs inför ett tufft val.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Dirty Pad
programme.desc: Det går utför för Angelina när alla får reda på att hon låg med Jose efter att hon haft ihop det med Vin. Sen blir hon för närgången men ett av Snookis ex. Sista droppen kommer när Mike hittar obehagligheter i badrummet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gone, Baby, Gone

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Emissiaries
programme.desc: NASA and others are developing new innovative propulsion systems, Ion thrusters, solar sails and the science fiction 'Warp drive' is not as far away as once thought.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Atmosphere
programme.desc: Our atmosphere is an unbelievably complex machine that protects us from the vacuum of space, shelters us from harmful radiation and allows us and the biosphere to breath; we need to learn much more about it so we can better it.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Danger, Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: The threat of an asteroid strike is a very real danger in our solar system, mankind is now in a position to defend the planet from such an eventuality.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living with Space
programme.desc: Astronauts and Cosmonauts train and study for years to work and live aboard the International Space Station. With this wealth of experience and insight behind them what do they think when they return to Earth?

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: När Matty flyttar in hos Hamiltons, upptäcker Jenna att samboende kanske är mer än hon vill ha.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spökena från Jennas förflutna visar sig tillsammans med hennes osäkerhet när Halloween drabbar Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jennas första dejt till återföreningsfesten lockar fram skuldkänslor för de tjejer som inte har någon dejt. Hon minns när hon var en av dem.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter en kopp kaffe med Collin en sen kväll kan Jenna inte sluta tänka på honom och vad det betyder att vara förtjust i någon annan än sin pojkvän.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Spänningar uppstår mellan Jenna och Matty när Collin bjuder in henne till en flott fotoutställning hemma hos sig.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter att ha impulsstrulat med Collin beslutar sig Jenna för att sluta med sitt vänsterprassel innan Matty får reda på det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Vad hände egentligen på överraskningsfesten - och är det verkligen helt slut mellan Jenna och Matty? Det vet bara de två, men deras vänner minns den ödesdigra stunden och försöker att fylla i luckorna.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna ställer till med grillfest för att hennes vänner ska vänja sig vid tanken på hennes och Collins spirande förhållande. Men när deras stöd uteblir av en eller annan orsak tar hon till drastiska åtgärder.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter att ha gjort sig ovän med Tamara och Ming tycker Jenna att det inte spelar nån roll vad hon gör längre - och hon hamnar i ett jobbigt läge.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val ber Mr Harts klass att skriva och framföra en egen skolpjäs, och sensmoralen i den är mer än välbekant.

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterverkningarna av Jennas gräl med vännerna gör att hon går ut en kväll. Men vad som skulle bli en kväll för att lätta på trycket blir en kväll hon behöver räddning från.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Sunk
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey hire a helicopter for a salvage mission to retrieve the rare tailpiece from a Lockheed 10-A that crashed in the Yellowknife woods forty years ago.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Turkey or Bust
programme.desc: Justin and Cory are stranded in Croatia while trying to complete the delivery of two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shootout
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot David faces a remote Arctic airstrip with sketchy landing gear. Mikey drafts a Buffalo hockey team to face off against an NHL squad in a charity shootout. Chuck gets a chance to shine on the ice.
